dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So why do you still keep watch here?

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because every beacon longs for its time to shine.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: Even if I knew for certain that there would never be a single storm again, once in a while my mind would be drawn to the stories they used to tell in my father's generation...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: The way our ancestors would defiantly blow the horn in the middle of a raging storm, sending a warning signal to all in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: And when I came back out of my reverie... I would find that I had walked all the way here, without realizing.
